title: ASAA ecosystem event envelope v1
description: Envelope for events POSTed to ASAA at /api/v1/integration/events. `id` is the idempotency key: re-delivery of the same id must be accepted without creating a duplicate.

type.description: Dotted event type, producer-prefixed, e.g. templates.generation.completed, templates.release.published, jarvis.task.completed, jarvis.security.alert, ci.build.completed

orgId.description: ASAA org_id the event belongs to

subject.description: Resource the event is about, producer-scoped id, e.g. generation/<uuid>

data.description: Type-specific payload. MUST NOT contain secrets, credentials, tokens, raw personal data or file contents. Max 16 KiB serialized.
